title: Muscular system anatomy: muscle groups and tendons
description: Every movement, every breath, every heartbeat's preload begins as muscle fibres sliding — here the skeletal set in écorché.

questions.question: How do skeletal muscles move joints?
questions.answer: Skeletal muscles contract and transmit force through tendons or other attachments to bones. Joint movement depends on the muscle's line of pull, attachments and cooperating muscles.

questions.question: What is the difference between a tendon and a ligament?
questions.answer: A tendon connects muscle to bone and transfers muscular force. A ligament connects bones across a joint and helps stabilize it.

questions.question: What is the deltoid?
questions.answer: Clavicle/scapula to humeral shaft. Function: Arm abduction beyond 15°.

questions.question: Where is the biceps brachii located?
questions.answer: Scapula to radial tuberosity. Function: Elbow flexion + supination.

questions.question: What is the function of the patellar tendon?
questions.answer: Function: Completes the knee extensor mechanism. Patella to tibial tuberosity.
